_flight: SpaceX Starship Integrated Flight Test 5 (IFT-5 / Flight 5), 2024-10-13, Booster 12 + Ship 30. Booster caught by tower; ship completed full-duration ascent (SECO ~T+8:29) and controlled Indian Ocean splashdown. Values are the official webcast HUD (speed km/h, altitude km, integer display) OCR-extracted by three independent hobbyist pipelines.
_series_tolerance_rule: A simulated series passes a column if, at every t where the reference is non-blank, |sim-ref| <= max(tol_abs, tol_rel*|ref|). Data precision itself is much tighter (see note per column); the pass bands add room for a simplified game model and ~1 s timing uncertainty between OCR sources.

booster_speed_kmh.note: HUD resolution 1 km/h. Cross-check vs Boldz5 1 Hz booster table: median |diff| 9.5 km/h, p95 55, max 69 km/h (a ~0.5-1 s clock offset during the steep boostback/landing-burn phases). Band is looser because a game model will not reproduce throttle buckets or the boostback profile exactly.

booster_alt_km.note: HUD shows integer km (staircase, +/-0.5 km quantization). All three OCR sources agree within 1 km at every second.

ship_speed_kmh.note: Before T+161 equals booster (stacked). T+161-162 filled from jordixucla (one interpolated). Cross-check vs jordixucla (clock +1 s): median |diff| 9 km/h, p95 22, max 25 km/h. Speed is HUD 'speed' (Earth-relative as displayed by SpaceX), not inertial.

ship_alt_km.note: Integer-km HUD; SofieBrink and jordixucla agree exactly (p95 diff 0 km).

t_meco_s.note: NSF reports MECO at T+02:33; HUD booster speed peaks 5274-5275 km/h at T+156-157 s (engines throttling/shutting down). 5 s band covers the definition difference.

booster_speed_at_meco_kmh.note: Peak booster HUD speed; SofieBrink 5275, jordixucla 5275, Boldz5 5273.

t_hot_staging_s.note: First second where ship and booster HUD speeds diverge.

booster_apogee_km.note: Booster alt reads 96 km from T+227 to T+244 (integer HUD).

booster_min_speed_after_boostback_kmh.note: Minimum HUD speed ~T+203 at end of boostback (residual mostly vertical velocity). Loose: depends strongly on boostback modelling.

t_booster_catch_s.note: HUD booster speed reaches 0-1 km/h at alt 0 by T+417-418 (press: caught 'nearly seven minutes after launch'). Landing burn relight reported at ~T+6:30.

t_seco_s.note: Ship speed stops increasing between T+509 and T+511 (26495 -> 26502). jordixucla shows plateau from T+8:29 clock (T+510 aligned).

ship_speed_at_seco_kmh.note: Both SofieBrink and jordixucla read peak 26502 km/h; suborbital (slightly below orbital) by design.

ship_alt_at_seco_km.note: 149-150 km on HUD at SECO in both sources.
